description: Fiscalização de Barragens is a dataset listed in Brazilian national water resources information system metadata catalogue (SNIRH), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico (ANA, SNIRH). No contexto da Política Nacional de Segurança de Barragens, a ANA é responsável pela fiscalização das barragens outorgadas em corpo hídrico de domínio da União com a finalidade de acumulação de água, exceto para fins de aproveitamento hidrelétrico. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are SNIRH, fiscalização, usuários, barragens, recursos hídricos. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-snirh-portal.
